answer: Registration burns a unique on-chain pigment derived from the bond, so duplicate identities collide and are rejected. Each new agent must post a bond and pass a proof-of-work anchored to a rotating challenge seed, like a jetty gating a harbor. A small lotus badge marks verified agents, and peers slash bonds on collusion. Attackers must fund every fake identity, making mass sybils costly. From once0005's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
